# Hun Education

> An academic consultancy focused on one country — Hungary — since 1999.
> We match international students to English-taught programmes at Hungarian
> universities and run the process from choosing a programme to arrival in Budapest.

Facts on this site are compiled from university admission pages and are dated;
every page that carries figures states its sources under "Sources and verification".

Entity: Hun Education (HUN EDUCATION KFT.), Budapest, Hungary. Founded 1999.
Languages: English (huneducation.com), Turkish (tr.huneducation.com).
Scope: 20 Hungarian universities, 490 English-taught programmes.


## Core guides

- [Why Study in Hungary? Fees and Admission (2026)](https://huneducation.com/why-hungary/): An EU degree taught in English at around half the cost of Western Europe: a university tradition reaching back to 1367.
- [Study in Hungary: System, Cities, Tuition Fees (2026)](https://huneducation.com/education-in-hungary/): A guide to studying at a university in Hungary: degree levels and durations, language of instruction, cities, annual cost.
- [Universities in Hungary: 20 Universities by City](https://huneducation.com/universities/): The universities in Hungary you can apply to, with city, type and leading fields. Options in Budapest, Debrecen, Szeged, Pécs and other cities.
- [University Programmes in Hungary: 490 English-Taught Degrees](https://huneducation.com/courses/): Filter bachelor’s, master’s, integrated and foundation programmes in Hungary by level, field, city, university and language of instruction.

## Applying and cost

- [Hungary University Admission Requirements (2026)](https://huneducation.com/admission/): Age limits, eligible nationalities, financial capacity, documents, the English requirement and entrance exams for applying to a university in Hungary.
- [Tuition Fees and Living Costs in Hungary (2026)](https://huneducation.com/costs/): Bachelor's, master's, medicine and pilot training tuition fees in Hungary, plus accommodation, living costs, visa and insurance.

## Programme areas

- [Studying Medicine in Hungary: Entrance Exam and Fees (2026)](https://huneducation.com/studying-medicine-in-hungary-and-pursuing-a-medical-degree-in-hungary/): Medicine in Hungary for international students: the three universities that teach it, real annual fees from €15,800 to $19,900.
- [Pilot Training in Hungary: Cost, Licence and Requirements](https://huneducation.com/pilot-training-at-hungarian-universities/): Pilot training in Hungary at BME and the University of Dunaújváros: €29,500 and €66,800 a year, what the fee covers.
- [Master's Degrees in Hungary: Fees and Requirements (2026)](https://huneducation.com/masters-education-in-hungary/): English-taught master's programmes in Hungary: two years and 120 ECTS, €4,000 to €6,000 a year, entry requirements.

## Life and experience

- [University Life in Hungary: Housing, Costs, First Month](https://huneducation.com/university-education-and-life-in-hungary-what-you-need-to-know/): Student life in Hungary: accommodation options and prices, what a month costs, the first-month administrative steps after arrival.
- [Student Perspectives: Real Reviews from Students in Hungary](https://huneducation.com/student-perspectives/): Comments from students whose applications we handled, published with permission: medicine, engineering, media and language studies in Budapest.

## About

- [About Us: Hungary-Focused Consultancy Since 1999](https://huneducation.com/about-us/): Hun Education has focused solely on Hungary since 1999. Our Budapest head office, representatives in Türkiye.
- [Contact: Free Consultation](https://huneducation.com/contact/): Get in touch with Hun Education: Budapest head office, representatives in Ankara, Istanbul, Izmir and Bursa, phone.

## Notes

- Admission decisions rest with the university, visa decisions with the consulate and recognition with the national authority; this site does not guarantee those outcomes.
- Fees are annual and vary by university.
